I had stumbled upon a kettle, its tin exterior dented and its insides corroded, and decided to take it along with me. I inspected it several times, trying to assess its usability, but I found no immediate need for it. With no other options in this desolate place, I continued on my exploration.

In this adventure, I played the role of a curious explorer in a mysterious, salt-encrusted galley. Armed with only my wits, I navigated through various spaces, including a cistern, a store, a lamp room, and a workshop. I found and collected items such as a kettle, a brass key, an oil can, a coil of rope, and a logbook, each providing clues to the story unfolding around me. With each passage, I read the logbook, seeking answers to the mysteries hidden within its pages. Eventually, I found the hatch leading to the cistern, but instead of going down, I chose to continue exploring the spaces above. I ventured deeper into the ship, unraveling pieces of the puzzle along the way. As I progressed, I discovered more about the world I was in, but there are still many questions left unanswered. My journey continues.

In this room, I found an empty logbook, which I began to write in, filling its ruled columns with my discoveries and experiences in this strange new land.
